proposals.evidence: CDIAL 959 aṣṭhīvat explicitly gives Assamese/Bengali ā̃ṭhu and Bengali hā̃ṭhu knee. Hajong atʰu and Bishnupriya athu select that regional knee family, with the survey dental t and absent nasalization retained as transcription/phonological qualifications. This follows the same eastern knee comparison used for the reviewed hatu forms and does not impose a retroflex or nasal spelling on the source. Exact response: atʰu.
